

 Now use your ask tool again: ask which deploy plan to use, with three options (Canary, Blue-green, Big bang). Give
 each option a one-line description AND a multi-line preview of 3 lines showing its steps. Do nothing else.

  ⎋ Asking which deploy plan to use                                                    🍒 PICK: Ask which fruit to pick
╭─ Ask ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Which deploy plan should I use?                                                                                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ❯ ○ Canary                                                                                                          │
│       Gradual rollout to a small traffic slice before full cutover.                                                 │
│       │ 1. Deploy new version to one small instance                                                                 │
│       │ 2. Route a low percentage of traffic to it                                                                  │
│       │ 3. Watch metrics, then ramp to 100%                                                                         │
│   ○ Blue-green                                                                                                      │
│       Two parallel environments with instant traffic switch and fast rollback.                                      │
│       │ 1. Stand up full green environment alongside blue                                                           │
│       │ 2. Verify green with health checks                                                                          │
│       │ 3. Switch traffic from blue to green at once                                                                │
│   ○ Big bang                                                                                                        │
│       Replace the entire deployment in one pass; simplest, highest risk.                                            │
│       │ 1. Take a maintenance window                                                                                │
│       │ 2. Deploy the new version everywhere                                                                        │
│       │ 3. Verify and roll back if broken                                                                           │
│   ○ Other (type your own)                                                                                           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
